row.evidence: sigmacomputing.com/pricing redirects to the Contact Us form, and Sigma's docs describe SCIM provisioning with a Sigma-generated bearer token and Directory base URL that 'can be applied across multiple IdPs (e.g. Okta, Azure, etc)'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Sigma publishes no plans or prices (the /pricing URL 308-redirects to /company/contact-us), so SCIM can only be bought through sales and no plan name is public. New row; vendor is Sigma Computing (slug kept as 'sigma'). SCIM requires SAML-only authentication (not 'SAML or password'), is tied to the admin who enabled it, and makes users and teams read-only in Sigma. Okta, Entra (gallery provisioning tutorial) and JumpCloud have SCIM apps; any other IdP can use the generic Directory base URL. SCIM deactivation keeps the user as inactive and transfers their documents to the admin who set up SCIM; users cannot be fully deleted. The REST API (/v2/members, /v2/teams) can create, update and deactivate users; no plan gate is published for it.

scim.base_url: Directory base URL generated in Admin Portal > Authentication > Account type and team provisioning

auth.token_source: Sigma Admin Portal > Authentication > Account type and team provisioning > Set up (token named by the admin)
auth.token_expiry: never (long-lived; tied to the admin who created it)

operations.notes: delete=false: Sigma users cannot be fully deleted, only deactivated.

deprovision.data_retained: Profile kept as an inactive user; documents transferred to the admin who set up SCIM (Okta: the admin performing the deactivation).

attributes.notes: Attribute list from Microsoft's Entra provisioning tutorial; userType carries the Sigma account type.

roles.how: userType attribute maps to a Sigma account type (admin, build, act, analyze, view or custom); default Lite if unset

limitations.text: SCIM only works with SAML-only authentication, not Password or 'SAML or password'.
Importing groups to an IdP from Sigma teams is not supported, and Sigma cannot guarantee SCIM works with any IdP.
Provisioning is bound to the admin who set it up; changing that admin requires re-enabling provisioning and a new token.
Changing a username creates a new Sigma account instead of renaming.
With SCIM on, users and teams can no longer be managed in Sigma; guest users are not supported.

scim.notes: Sigma's docs do not state the SCIM version or publish a SCIM API reference; endpoint and attribute facts come from the IdP guides.

auth.notes: Client ID and secret exchanged at POST /v2/auth/token for a bearer token.

endpoints.purpose: Update a member (isArchived for pre-SCIM users)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are a Sigma Audit Logs connection (and cloud-storage export) that Sigma Support or the account executive must enable; the API only reads or toggles the setting.

limitations.text: DELETE /v2/members should not be used for SCIM-provisioned members.

okta.notes: Sigma's docs refer to the Sigma app in Okta's marketplace with SCIM provisioning; okta.com/integrations/sigma-computing/ and /sigma/ return 404.
